verdict: Lead volume has stalled; ad spend cuts and overdue work are the cause.
narrative: You received 16 leads over the last 28 days, with zero leads recorded in the past six-plus days — the last meaningful cluster was October 1–3. The immediate driver is a sharp drop in Google Ads spend, which averaged $23 per day October 8–12 versus $107 per day at the start of the month, pulling paid lead volume out of the pipeline entirely. Nine planned deliverables — including heating campaign launches, LSA re-enable, and fall creative — remain incomplete and are blocking the scale-up path that was due to begin this month. Google Ads spend is being restored and the overdue items are being resolved in priority order this week. Once spend stabilizes at its intended level and the heating campaigns are live, lead volume should recover through the remainder of October.
